_meta.methodology: Reviewed publicly accessible official operator pages only: location pages, membership pages, pricing pages, booking price pages, FAQs, and official location directories. Recorded monthlyPrice as the lowest clearly published recurring in-person membership when the source made it safe to compare; recorded dayPassPrice as a single class, single workout, day pass, or drop-in amount only when a dollar amount was explicit. Intro, founding, local-resident, prepaid, and promotional rates are described in priceNote but are not used as the primary numeric price unless the note explicitly says the value is the regular recurring option. No third-party aggregators, review sites, or scraped maps were used as price evidence.
limitations: Some official pages hide live prices behind JavaScript, a booking account, location selection, or a sales inquiry form.
Several boutique studios publish class-pack or intro pricing more clearly than recurring memberships. Those values are preserved in notes rather than forced into monthlyPrice.
Prices, fees, taxes, commitments, freezes, and eligibility restrictions can change; verify with the operator before publication.
For multi-location operators, a single official pricing page may apply to all listed San Francisco locations. The priceNote field explains when this was used.
